fn configuration(cli: &Cli, args: &Args) -> Result<Configuration, String> {
    if cli.config.is_some() || cli.ignore_file.is_some() {
        return Err(
            "clones does not consume legacy --config or --ignore-file; use --matching-config"
                .into(),
        );
    }
    let value = args
        .matching_config
        .as_deref()
        .map(read_json::<Value>)
        .transpose()?
        .unwrap_or_else(|| json!({}));
    Ok(Configuration {
        compiler_advisory: advisory::configuration(args)?,
        compiler_pattern_baseline: args
            .compiler_pattern_baseline
            .as_deref()
            .map(review::compiler_pattern_baseline::load)
            .transpose()?,
        compiler_baseline: args
            .compiler_baseline
            .as_deref()
            .map(review::compiler_baseline::load)
            .transpose()?,
        matching: rstyle_ccgraph::parse_config(&value).map_err(|e| e.message)?,
        analysis: analysis::configuration(args)?,
        mutation: analysis::mutation_reports::configuration(args)?,
        effects: analysis::effect_reports::configuration(args)?,
        source_baseline: args
            .source_baseline
            .as_deref()
            .map(review::source_baseline::load)
            .transpose()?,
        density_baseline: args
            .density_baseline
            .as_deref()
            .map(review::density_baseline::load)
            .transpose()?,
    })
}

contracts.evidence: from_bundle_with requires independent borrowed frontend inspection before strict evidence validation and delegates without decoding twice.
from_current_run verifies the supplied manifest before selecting the current-run path; from_verified_current_run consumes already sealed immutable bytes.
Decoded::into_store owns structural table construction and structural reference validation; load_bundle delegates rather than reimplements it.
generated and strict run FnOnce under a scoped thread-local setting restored on return/unwind; imported replay explicitly selects strict despite ambient setting.
Each Stage::observe executes the operation once and retains its Result independently of diagnostic IO.

call_sites.evidence: load_unit supplies an inspection closure checking frontend invocation, receiver inventory and library evidence, then obtains nominal bindings; replay selects from_bundle_with and current run selects from_verified_current_run.
owned_snapshot_retains_checked_bytes_and_import_inspection separately exercises successful inspection and rejection from a wrong selected-unit callback.

review.rationale: The function is the single shared boundary for decode, independent inspection, structural import and evidence validation. Its order is documented and exercised by real callers. review.limits: No claim about metrics, purity, runtime overhead, completeness of imported evidence, or desirability of the existing policy architecture. The review does not recommend expanding that architecture or adding validation. It only finds no concrete style-driven refactor of this orchestration function.
